agents.title: Company-wide agents policy
agents.description: Choose how agents work across your company. Changes take effect immediately for everyone.

off.label: Agents Off
off.desc: Agents are disabled for everyone. The Agents UI shows a notice that it is disabled and to contact an admin.

personal.label: Personal Agents Only
personal.desc: Users can create and use personal agents. Company sharing is disabled and the Company Agent Marketplace is hidden.

full.label: Agents On (Full)
full.desc: Users can create and use personal agents and share company agents. The marketplace is available.

confirm.off: Turn off Agents for everyone? Users will not be able to create or use agents. The Agents UI will display a disabled notice. Continue?
confirm.personal: Disable company agent sharing? The Company Agent Marketplace will be hidden and users can only create and use personal agents. Existing company agents will be hidden. Continue?
confirm.full: Enable Agents and company sharing for everyone?

agents.footerNote: Users will still see gentle hints where agents are disabled (e.g., "Agents are disabled. Contact your admin").

securitySettings.title: Security & Session
securitySettings.description: Configure session expiry policies and MFA device trust for all users.

sessionExpiry.title: Session Expiry
sessionExpiry.idleTimeoutHelp: Log users out after this many minutes of inactivity (max {{max}}). Set to 0 to disable.
sessionExpiry.idleDisabled: Idle timeout is disabled. Sessions will not expire due to inactivity.
sessionExpiry.maxDurationHelp: Force re-login after this many hours, regardless of activity (max {{max}}). Set to 0 for no limit. This is enforced server-side.
sessionExpiry.maxDurationDisabled: No maximum session duration. Sessions last until the user logs out.

validation.idleTimeout: Idle timeout must be between 0 and {{max}} minutes.
validation.maxDuration: Max session duration must be between 0 and {{max}} hours.
validation.mfaDuration: MFA remember duration must be between 0 and {{max}} {{unit}}.

mfaSettings.title: Device Trust Duration
mfaSettings.description: Configure how long users can skip two-factor authentication on trusted devices. Set to 0 to require MFA on every login. Reducing the duration takes effect on the next login — existing device trust that exceeds the new window will require MFA again.
mfaSettings.durationHelp: Users who check 'Remember this device' will skip MFA for the selected duration (max {{maxHours}}h / {{maxDays}} days).
mfaSettings.zeroMeansAlways: MFA will be required on every login. No 'Remember this device' option will be shown to users.
mfaSettings.saveSuccess: MFA device trust settings saved successfully.

approval.description: Control how integration tool calls are approved when using Numa. This setting applies to actions performed through connected integrations (e.g. Google Drive, Slack).
approval.label: Approval mode

always.label: Always require approval
always.help: Every integration action will require your explicit approval before it runs. This is the safest option.

non_destructive.label: Auto-approve safe actions
non_destructive.help: Read-only actions (e.g. searching, listing files) will run automatically. Actions that create, modify, or delete data will still require your approval. Actions without safety metadata will also require approval.

never.label: Auto-approve all actions
never.help: All integration actions will run automatically without approval prompts. Use this only if you fully trust the integrations and agents you use.
